name: xml declaration, comment, title and desc
svg:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- logo -->
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><title>Demo</title><desc>The Demo logo</desc>
  <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
</svg>

name: linear gradient by url(#g)
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><defs><linearGradient id="g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1" gradientUnits="objectBoundingBox"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f00" stop-opacity="1"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#00f"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="24" height="24" rx="4" fill="url(#g)"/></svg>

name: use href="#a" and xlink:href="#a"
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><defs><symbol id="a" viewBox="0 0 10 10"><polygon points="0,0 10,0 5,10"/></symbol></defs><use href="#a" width="10" height="10"/><use xlink:href="#a" x="12" width="10" height="10"/></svg>

name: clipPath and mask
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"><defs><clipPath id="c"><ellipse cx="12" cy="12" rx="10" ry="8"/></clipPath><mask id="m"><rect width="24" height="24" fill="#fff"/></mask><radialGradient id="r" gradientTransform="scale(1)"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff"/></radialGradient></defs><g clip-path="url(#c)" mask="url(#m)" transform="rotate(45 12 12)" opacity="0.9"><path d="M0 0L24 24" fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" fill="url(#r)" fill-opacity="0.5"/><line x1="0" y1="24" x2="24" y2="0" stroke="#000"/><polyline points="0,0 1,1"/></g></svg>
